changelog:
Version 1.0.0
Initial release of skill-eval-preflight.

A lightweight authoring-side preflight for OpenClaw skills before deeper evaluation.

This release includes:

scaffolding for evals/ files
readiness checks for a first evaluation pass
review of positive and negative trigger coverage
validation of eval prompts and expected artifacts
static with-skill / without-skill comparison outputs
detection of missing, empty, or unfinished eval scaffolding
Current scope:

focuses on authoring-side validation and release readiness
does not perform live runtime evaluation or output quality scoring
